title: Gurukul Grammar students attend science demonstration at IIT Guwahati

ai.summary: A group of 110 Class XII science students from Gurukul Grammar Senior Secondary School visited IIT Guwahati for a science demonstration under the Pandit Hemchandra Mission.

facts.claim: A group of 110 Class XII science students from Gurukul Grammar Senior Secondary School, Guwahati, visited the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Guwahati on November 23 for an interactive science demonstration under the 'Pandit Hemchandra Mission for Popularization of Science and Assamese Culture'.
